name: amlog-spider-crawler
description: Watch what your AI agents actually do (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity): a line-drawn spider follows every read, edit and search live, and each issue gets an agent-trace.json you can replay, with phases, what led to each step, and signals worth a second look.

commands.title: AMLOG: Show Agent Trace for This Code
AMLOG: Copy Trace Summary for PR

amlog.autoRevealOnWrite.description: Reveal the file in an editor when an agent writes to it.

amlog.decorationTtlMs.description: How long (ms) the spider decoration lingers on a file after a read/write before fading.

amlog.showDecorations.description: Show the gutter spider + line highlight on files agents touch.

amlog.trailLength.description: How many recently touched files each agent's silk trail connects in the crawl map.

enumDescriptions: Read the Claude Code session transcripts (full detail: Bash reads/searches, exact lines, captions, tokens). The hook file is used only for sessions without a transcript.
Only use the PostToolUse hook file (.amlog/activity/events.ndjson).
amlog.captureSource.description: Where agent activity is captured from. Reload the window after changing.

amlog.sessionLookbackMinutes.description: On startup, replay Claude Code sessions active within this many minutes (into the recap and trace).

amlog.writeTraceFile.description: Write each session into docs/<issue>/agent-trace.json (the folder holding the issue instructions.md / plan.md), or .amlog/traces/ when no issue folder is found.

amlog.agentSources.description: Which agents' session logs to follow for this workspace (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI). Only sessions that worked in this workspace (or another worktree of its repository) are read. Reload the window after changing.

amlog.resolveSymbols.description: Name the function/class an agent touched (e.g. "edited parseInvoice()") from the repo's CodeGraph index, for steps that happen while the extension is running. Needs Node 22+ in VS Code and a CodeGraph index; silently off otherwise. Reload the window after changing.
